# Creation script for Material Library LOP operator.

# Add the Tab Menu Mask spare parameter to limit the Tab menu inside to 
# light filter VOPs and MaterialX pattern VOPs to drive their inputs.
node = kwargs['node']

mask_parm = hou.properties.parmTemplate('op','tabmenumask')
mask_parm.setDefaultValue(["*builder parameter constant rampparm collect null subnet subnetconnector suboutput subinput genericshader"])

folder = hou.FolderParmTemplate('tabmenufolder', "Tab Menu",
        folder_type=hou.folderType.Collapsible)
folder.addParmTemplate(mask_parm)

parms = node.parmTemplateGroup()
parms.insertAfter( 'matpathprefix', folder )
node.setParmTemplateGroup( parms )

# Set the initial parameter to glob all children inside.
# Configure the multiparm. The multiparm default value is 1, so there
# is already a place to specify materials. The most common user workflow
# is to dive in and put material VOP nodes, so configure the LOP for it:
# glob all children and pick the ones with the "material" flag set.
node.parm('matnode1').set( "*" )
node.parm('matflag1').set( 1 )
node.parm('assign1').set( 0 )

def defineMatOnLibraryNode(liblop, matvop):
    containerpath = liblop.parm("containerpath").eval()
    if containerpath.endswith("/"):
        containerpath = containerpath[:-1]
    matsparm = liblop.parm("materials")
    nmats = matsparm.eval()
    # Find a multiparm instance that has all parms at default. We can reuse
    # that.
    folderpts = matsparm.parmTemplate().parmTemplates()
    index = -1
    for i in range(1, nmats + 1):
        for pt in folderpts:
            instparm = liblop.parm(pt.name().replace("#", str(i)))
            if not instparm.isAtDefault():
                break
        else:
            # all parms at default, use this index
            index = i
            break
    if index == -1:
        index = nmats + 1
        matsparm.set(index)
    liblop.parm("matnode" + str(index)).set(liblop.relativePathTo(matvop))
    matprimpath = containerpath + "/" + matvop.name()
    liblop.parm("matpath" + str(index)).set(matprimpath)
    return matprimpath

def getMaterialPrimPathForNode(liblop, vop):
    for matpath in loputils.globPrimPaths(liblop, '%type(Material)'):
        editnodes = loputils.getEditorNodes(liblop, matpath)
        if vop not in editnodes:
            continue
        break
    else:
        matpath = defineMatOnLibraryNode(liblop, vop)
    return matpath

def assignMat(primpath, matpath, node):
    assignmattype = hou.nodeType(hou.lopNodeTypeCategory(), "assignmaterial")
    assignmatnode = None
    if node.type().name() == "assignmaterial":
        assignmatnode = node
    else:
        assignmatnode = loptoolutils.createLopNode(node.parent(),
            "assignmaterial", [node], "assignmaterial",
            primstring = primpath,
            selection_parm_name = "primpattern1")
        assignmatnode.parm("matspecpath1").set(matpath)
        assignmatnode.setCurrent(True, True)
        return

    multiparm = assignmatnode.parm("nummaterials")
    numassigns = multiparm.eval()
    # Index of a an existing assignment instance with the correct material path
    index = -1
    alreadyassigned = False
    removalerror = False

    for i in range(1, numassigns+1):
        patternparm = assignmatnode.parm("primpattern{}".format(i))
        matparm = assignmatnode.parm("matspecpath{}".format(i))
        rule = hou.LopSelectionRule()
        pattern = patternparm.eval()
        rule.setPathPattern(pattern)

endif

# Creation script for Material Library LOP operator.

# Add the Tab Menu Mask spare parameter to limit the Tab menu inside to 
# light filter VOPs and MaterialX pattern VOPs to drive their inputs.
node = kwargs['node']

mask_parm = hou.properties.parmTemplate('op','tabmenumask')
mask_parm.setDefaultValue(["*builder parameter constant rampparm collect null subnet subnetconnector suboutput subinput genericshader"])

folder = hou.FolderParmTemplate('tabmenufolder', "Tab Menu",
        folder_type=hou.folderType.Collapsible)
folder.addParmTemplate(mask_parm)

parms = node.parmTemplateGroup()
parms.insertAfter( 'matpathprefix', folder )
node.setParmTemplateGroup( parms )

# Set the initial parameter to glob all children inside.
# Configure the multiparm. The multiparm default value is 1, so there
# is already a place to specify materials. The most common user workflow
# is to dive in and put material VOP nodes, so configure the LOP for it:
# glob all children and pick the ones with the "material" flag set.
node.parm('matnode1').set( "*" )
node.parm('matflag1').set( 1 )
node.parm('assign1').set( 0 )

def defineMatOnLibraryNode(liblop, matvop):
    containerpath = liblop.parm("containerpath").eval()
    if containerpath.endswith("/"):
        containerpath = containerpath[:-1]
    matsparm = liblop.parm("materials")
    nmats = matsparm.eval()
    # Find a multiparm instance that has all parms at default. We can reuse
    # that.
    folderpts = matsparm.parmTemplate().parmTemplates()
    index = -1
    for i in range(1, nmats + 1):
        for pt in folderpts:
            instparm = liblop.parm(pt.name().replace("#", str(i)))
            if not instparm.isAtDefault():
                break
        else:
            # all parms at default, use this index
            index = i
            break
    if index == -1:
        index = nmats + 1
        matsparm.set(index)
    liblop.parm("matnode" + str(index)).set(liblop.relativePathTo(matvop))
    matprimpath = containerpath + "/" + matvop.name()
    liblop.parm("matpath" + str(index)).set(matprimpath)
    return matprimpath

def getMaterialPrimPathForNode(liblop, vop):
    for matpath in loputils.globPrimPaths(liblop, '%type(Material)'):
        editnodes = loputils.getEditorNodes(liblop, matpath)
        if vop not in editnodes:
            continue
        break
    else:
        matpath = defineMatOnLibraryNode(liblop, vop)
    return matpath

def assignMat(primpath, matpath, node):
    assignmattype = hou.nodeType(hou.lopNodeTypeCategory(), "assignmaterial")
    assignmatnode = None
    if node.type().name() == "assignmaterial":
        assignmatnode = node
    else:
        assignmatnode = loptoolutils.createLopNode(node.parent(),
            "assignmaterial", [node], "assignmaterial",
            primstring = primpath,
            selection_parm_name = "primpattern1")
        assignmatnode.parm("matspecpath1").set(matpath)
        assignmatnode.setCurrent(True, True)
        return

    multiparm = assignmatnode.parm("nummaterials")
    numassigns = multiparm.eval()
    # Index of a an existing assignment instance with the correct material path
    index = -1
    alreadyassigned = False
    removalerror = False

    for i in range(1, numassigns+1):
        patternparm = assignmatnode.parm("primpattern{}".format(i))
        matparm = assignmatnode.parm("matspecpath{}".format(i))
        rule = hou.LopSelectionRule()
        pattern = patternparm.eval()
        rule.setPathPattern(pattern)
